final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), totals AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count FROM state_counts), state_shares AS (SELECT s.BillingState, s.invoice_count, 1.0 * s.invoice_count / t.total_count AS share FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_count AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS mean_count FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.invoice_count - m.mean_count) FROM state_shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_count AS m WHERE m.mean_count IS NOT NULL AND s.invoice_count > m.mean_count
